Experience in Linux-based development environments and version control workflows. Ability to read schematics and collaborate with hardware and software teams during integration. Strong lab debug and root-cause analysis skills for hardware/firmware issues. BS in Computer, Electrical, or Software Engineering, or equivalent experience; 4-7 years of relevant engineering experience. jobs.description: This highly visible role will help drive AWS's global go-to-market strategy for Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), developing holistic strategies that build awareness, generate demand, and grow revenue across the full ISV flywheel: selling to, with, and through our software partners.
